text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship was acting even stranger than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Trainer-san! With such clear 
skies, it is a perfect day for training♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Today's training menu is hill sprints. It 
is simply ideal for building stamina♪ 
Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now, let us give it our all today as well!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh dear me, my legs simply won't move~!

"...Did running consecutive races take its 
toll? She seems heavily fatigued, so we 
may need to reconsider her race 
schedule..."
